Coram : SANJAY KISHAN KAUL*, M.M. SUNDRESH
Penal Code, 1860 – s.302 r/w s.34 – Murder – Common intention – On the fateful night at about 3 a.m., the victim and his wife (eye witness) woke up and while the wife was doing preparations for cooking, the husband went to attend to the nature’s call – Wife when she ran to the site she saw two accused assaulting her husband with an axe whereas the appellants had caught hold of him – She found him bleeding, he also told her that four of them had caught hold of him and assaulted him by an axe – He was taken to hospital, was declared
Decision Date : 28-07-2022 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 143/2020 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
